name.ja: 30MS オプションパーツセット28(アクションウエアα)[カラーA]
name.en: 30MS Option Parts Set 28 (Action Wear α) [Color A]

description.ja: 30MS素体との組み合わせでカスタマイズの幅が広がる！これまでよりもさらに可動域を広げ、新規ギミックを盛り込んだオールインワンアイテムが登場！
description.en: The range of customization expands when combined with the 30MS body! Introducing an all-in-one item that has a wider range of motion than before and incorporates new gimmicks!

description.ja: ■腰部と脚部に新たな可動ギミックが追加。
description.en: • New movable gimmicks have been added to the waist and legs.

description.ja: ■腕、脚に装着可能なリングタイプのジョイントパーツも多数付属。
description.en: • Many ring-type joint parts that can be attached to arms and legs are also included.

description.ja: ■「30 MINUTES SISTERS」はフェイスパーツ/ヘアスタイルパーツ/ボディパーツを部位ごとにラインアップ展開。別売りのパーツと組み替えて自分好みのシスターを創ることができる。
description.en: • "30 MINUTES SISTERS" offers a lineup of face parts, hairstyle parts, and body parts by body part. You can create your own sister by combining parts sold separately.

description.ja: ■30 MINUTESシリーズ共通の3mmジョイントを採用。「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」のパーツもオプションとして装着が可能。(※「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」キットの対象年齢は8才以上です)
description.en: • Adopts a 3mm joint common to the 30 MINUTES series. "30 MINUTES MISSIONS " parts can also be installed as options. (*" 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" Kit is for ages 8 and up)

accessories.ja: 無塗装フェイスパーツ×1
胸部パーツ(差し替え)×2種
